references.label: ESMA MiCA Article 3 definitions: structural ART/EMT exclusion for variable-value strategy vault shares

applicabilityBasis.summary: fLiteUSD represents Ethereum FluidLiteVaultProxy 0x273da948aca9261043fbdb2a857bc255ecc29012, a yield-accruing USDC strategy vault share. Verified implementation source calculates redemption from an auto-accruing exchange price less a configurable withdrawal fee (5 bps as of 2026-11-27), drawing from a Fluid fUSDC liquidity buffer while the 71.83% strategy residual is deployed in multi-strategy contracts. Holders burn shares for available USDC without a fixed-monetary-value payment-stablecoin redemption obligation under GENIUS Act section 2(22).

genius.notes: Assessment applies to the fLiteUSD strategy vault share separately from underlying Circle USDC. Variable-value ERC-4626 strategy vault shares are treated as non-payment tokens under this tracker. Underlying USDC authorizations and reserve reports are not attributed to fLiteUSD, and this scope assessment does not decide securities, investment-company, or other legal treatment.
